papers.markingGuideNote: The scheme awards attempt marks of 2 for a 5-mark step. Deduct 3 for a mathematical error, or 1 for a numerical slip or minor misreading. A serious error that oversimplifies the task receives attempt marks only. Valid alternative methods are accepted. Do not deduct an error twice.
papers.boundaryReview: Q2(a)(i) magnitude and direction share a single final 5-mark brace and remain one 15-mark response. Q2(b) direction and magnitude have separate final marks; direction receives the shared component work (20); the diagram shows an alternative credit for the first component relationship, not an extra sixth 5-mark step, magnitude 5. Q3(a)(i) both tan values share a 5-mark step; (ii) both flight times share a 5-mark brace, so both pairs remain joint. Q4(a)(i) asks one common acceleration of Q and R, not two answers; part (a) and part (b) use separate source pages. Q6(a)(ii) the SHM proof and period have separate final placements (10 and 5). Q7(b)(i) reactions at Y and X have separate 5-mark placements. Q10(a)(i) both speeds share a 5-mark brace. Q10(a)(iii) the paired curves receive one sketch allocation (5), and shading is a separate 5-mark task; both keep the whole graph context. There are no finite answer-option pools.
